native16_metrics.scope: Full-budget native-LoRA engineering benchmark, not a mathematics accuracy report. Physical telemetry includes load/display overhead.

scope: Engineering throughput only on64 identical development prompts. BF16 merge changes numerics and can change trajectory lengths, so token/s and samples/s are both reported. Not mathematics efficacy, native-LoRA equivalence or a replacement protocol. Compare device identity and observed operating conditions before interpreting speed ratios. Source training checkpoints and existing formal outputs unchanged.
resource_decision: Use native-LoRA64 for the next separately frozen evaluation preset. Dense16 saves only about5% batch wall time over native64 on this run, requires independent weight exports and changes BF16 model numerics. No math accuracy was measured; do not claim dense efficacy or adopt it as a score-compatible replacement.
